plan.understanding: Add a 6.35 mm fillet to the one long sharp edge along the blade that currently has no radius.

subtasks.goal: Apply an edge fillet of radius R=6.35 mm (from 0.635 cm) to the single long sharp edge along the blade’s length (the long perimeter edge on the blade arm adjacent to planar face #42 or planar face #43) that currently has no radius; ensure only that one long edge is rounded and do not fillet other blade edges that are already radiused.
